summary: Propose a staged PCFL core and a compact fail-closed clean-source/disposable-descendant boundary: first prove a deterministic, visibility-safe, explicit-text M relay at root level; then independently gate E0 and LoRA transport; then add separately reduced L and C shells with no pooled units, evidence, or claims. The source remains immutable; all experiment learning is root-local and terminal.
system_thesis: Dream–LoRA–Think is an organism-level developmental hypothesis: lived action/outcome episodes supply grounded evidence; DREAM locally re-expresses and connects that evidence under strict visibility and later prediction checks; SLEEP compiles only supported transitions; a LoRA, when eligible, transports rather than discovers those semantics; THINK retrieves, composes, plans, acts, and revises under goals; later outcomes can enter future local dream cycles only within the registered descendant life. M tests this relay in fixed-child roots, L tests increasing-lifetime use against a certified evolving text-memory agent in independent lineages, and C tests a separate semantic code. Neither an organ alone nor a receipt/manifest alone earns the full claim.
